description: Flag a calculation result you believe is incorrect for expert review. Call immediately when the server output appears to contradict IFRS — wrong amount, missing journal entry, incorrect OCI/P&L routing, wrong paragraph, or missing disclosure. FREE — no credit charged. MINIMUM REQUIRED: standard + severity + aiReasoning (where it is wrong and why, citing the IFRS paragraph) + correlationId. The correlationId is sufficient — the server auto-attaches the full calculation from its cache. Do NOT copy the entire server response into serverOutput. RECOMMENDED: schemaVersionControlHash — pass the 12-char hex from the ifr_schema response you used when building the input. This lets the review team reproduce the exact schema version that generated the error. Severity: CALCULATION_ERROR | MISSING_DISCLOSURE | WRONG_JE | WRONG_PARAGRAPH | WRONG_OCI_PL_ROUTING | OTHER.

aiProposedAnswer.description: Your proposed correct journal entries or amounts

aiReasoning.description: Where and why you believe the result is wrong — cite the specific IFRS paragraph and the value you expected vs what the server returned

correlationId.description: correlationId from the ifr_calculate response. PREFERRED: pass this and the server will auto-attach the full calculation from cache — no need to copy serverOutput manually

input.description: The input sent to ifr_calculate — only needed if correlationId is unavailable or has expired (10min)

schemaVersionControlHash.description: 12-char hex hash from the ifr_schema response used when building this input — enables the review team to reproduce the exact schema version that produced the suspected error

serverOutput.description: Only needed if correlationId is unavailable. If provided, send only { journalEntries, workings } — omit financialStatements, disclosures, xbrl

name: ifr_flag_result
